name: keyzula
description: Use passwords and API keys from your KeyZula vault without Claude seeing them.

allow_reveal.title: Allow showing values
allow_reveal.description: Offer read_secret (passwords, 2FA codes). Every request still needs your approval in a KeyZula window on your computer.

confirm.title: Ask before every use
confirm.description: Also ask for approval before each command or file that uses a secret.

service_token.title: Service account token (optional)
service_token.description: For teams: a kzsa_1_ token limits Claude to the service account's collections. Leave empty to use your own unlocked agent.
